title: WT-1 Staining Protocol for Podocytes
author: Frank Brosius
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8e2htge
materials: Dip in 70% ETOH 5 minutes in once
Soak in PBS and store at 4ºC.
Blot dry slide (leave the section wet)
Stop reaction in dH ² O

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Perform a series of dips to remove paraffin and hydrate the tissue sections.

substeps.instruction: Dip in Xylene for 5 minutes, 2x (perform in hood)
Dip in 100% ETOH for 5 minutes, 2x
Dip in 95% ETOH for 5 minutes, 1x
Dip in 70% ETOH for 5 minutes, 1x
Dip in dH2O for 5 minutes, 2x
Dip in PBS for 5 minutes, 1x

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform heat-induced epitope retrieval using Retrieve All 1.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in a jar with preheated Retrieve All 1 and incubate for 2 hours in a 90ºC water bath
Remove slides and allow to cool for 5-10 minutes
Pour off solution and add dH2O
Rinse slides in two changes of dH2O for 4-5 minutes each

steps.title: Store Slides
steps.instruction: Soak slides in PBS and store at 4ºC until Day 2.

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Blot the slide dry (keeping the section wet) and incubate with blocking serum for 20 minutes at room temperature (RT), following Vectastain ABS Kit dilution directions.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with WT-1 primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Dilute WT-1 antibody 1:200 in 1% BSA
Blot excess serum and incubate with primary antibody (2ug/section in 100ul) for 2 hours at RT

steps.title: Wash and Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Wash sections and apply the secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Wash in PBS for 5-10 minutes (2x changes) and blot dry without touching the section
Incubate with second antibody for 1 hour, following Vectastain ABS Kit dilution directions

steps.title: Wash and Quench Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Wash sections and quench endogenous peroxidase activity.

substeps.instruction: Wash in PBS for 5-10 minutes (2x changes)
Dip in 1% H2O2 in methanol for 45 minutes
Wash in PBS for 10-15 minutes (2x changes)

steps.title: ABC Reagent Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with ABC Reagent for 1 hour, following Vectastain ABS Kit dilution directions.

steps.title: DAB Staining
steps.instruction: Wash sections and develop the signal using DAB substrate.

substeps.instruction: Wash in PBS for 5-10 minutes
Prepare DAB Tablets by dissolving 1 set in 5 ml ddH2O and filtering
Add approximately 100ul of DAB substrate to cover the whole section
Check under the microscope for podocyte nuclei (~1 minute)
Stop the reaction in dH2O

steps.title: Dehydrate and Clear Slides
steps.instruction: Perform a series of dips to dehydrate and clear the sections for mounting.

substeps.instruction: Dip in dH2O for 5 minutes, 2x
Dip in 70% ETOH for 5 minutes, 1x
Dip in 95% ETOH for 5 minutes, 1x
Dip in 100% ETOH for 5 minutes, 2x
Dip in Xylene for 5 minutes, 2x (perform in hood)
